title: tvbuff.h: Doxygen the rest of it

notes.body: I don't think it is unclear at all, but noticing that this line doesn't explicitly say if is a pointer type.
Most of the times the docs aren't explicit about the type. I don't know if explicitly stating pointer vs non-pointer adds value since the parameter type is a pointer.
